title: Drosophila DNp03 descending neurons serve as a hub within a flight saccade network.
source_locator: Results, 'Unilateral DNp03 activation drives saccades...'; Fig. 4A-F; Video S1
quote: When we unilaterally activated DNp03, flies increased the ipsilateral WBA and decreased the contralateral WBA
mapping_basis: DNp03 is the MANC/Namiki type name in type_list.csv; driver SS01559 maps only to DNp03 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 627 nm LED aimed at the thorax, 100 ms, 29.5 mW/cm2 at the fly; three trials per fly
type_coverage: one of the two DNp03 neurons (left or right) by stochastic FLP-out; bilateral expression ~2%
sensory_condition: tethered flight, near-IR illumination, high-speed video from above (3000 frames/s)
coordination_notes: fictive saccade: ipsilateral WBA up, contralateral WBA down; head turns away from the activated side
n_flies_note: right DNp03 21 trials (7 flies), left DNp03 18 trials (6 flies); genetically matched no-expression controls 18 trials (6 flies)
notes: Flight experiment. SLEAP tracked only the head, wing tips and wing hinges; the legs are not described, so all leg fields are not_assessed (PROTOCOL sec. 3, wing/flight behaviours). The paper's leg-extension scoring (Fig. 7G-J) comes from looming stimuli in control and Kir2.1-silenced flies, not from activation.

title: Drosophila DNp03 descending neurons serve as a hub within a flight saccade network.
source_locator: Results, 'Bilateral DNp03 activation drives wing, head, and body motions of a saccade'; Fig. 6A-D; Video S4
quote: bilateral activation resulted in an increase in both WBAs (Figure 6B, D, Video S4)
mapping_basis: DNp03 is the MANC/Namiki type name in type_list.csv; driver SS01559 maps only to DNp03 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 627 nm LED aimed at the thorax, 100 ms, 29.5 mW/cm2 at the fly; three trials per fly
type_coverage: both DNp03 neurons (split-GAL4 driving CsChrimson directly)
sensory_condition: tethered flight, near-IR illumination, high-speed video from above (3000 frames/s)
coordination_notes: both WBAs increased; absolute R-L WBA showed a non-significant trend upward (p = 0.34)
n_flies_note: 27 trials (9 flies); no-retinal control 27 trials (9 flies)
notes: Flight experiment. Only wing (and head) kinematics were tracked; the legs are not described, so all leg fields are not_assessed (PROTOCOL sec. 3).

title: Drosophila DNp03 descending neurons serve as a hub within a flight saccade network.
source_locator: Results, 'Bilateral DNp03 activation drives wing, head, and body motions of a saccade'; Fig. 6E-M; Video S5
quote: We found dual DNp03 activation increased the wing stroke amplitudes (WSA) of both wings (Figure 6G)
mapping_basis: DNp03 is the MANC/Namiki type name in type_list.csv; driver SS01559 maps only to DNp03 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: collimated 625 nm LED, 100 ms, triggered when the fly entered the chamber centre
type_coverage: both DNp03 neurons (split-GAL4 driving CsChrimson directly)
sensory_condition: free flight in a transparent chamber; three orthogonal high-speed cameras at 8000 frames/s, near-IR backlight
coordination_notes: both WSAs increased, absolute R-L WSA increased (turning); body pitched up, roll and yaw increased
n_flies_note: 103 trials (50 flies); empty split-GAL4 SS01062 control 48 trials (53 flies) as printed
notes: Free-flight experiment. The hull reconstruction gives body and wing kinematics only; the legs are not described, so all leg fields are not_assessed (PROTOCOL sec. 3). Separate record from 0002 because the preparation differs.

title: Synaptic gradients transform object location to action.
source_locator: Extended Data Fig. 1e,f (figure file Fig7_ESM) and source data; Fig. 1e,f (DNp03 pooled); Supplementary Table 1 p. 3-4
quote: Only DNp04, DNp11 and combination line activation increased takeoff rates significantly compared to that of controls
mapping_basis: DNp03 is the MANC/Namiki type name in type_list.csv; driver SS01081 maps only to DNp03 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: four 624-nm LEDs, total irradiance 500 W m-2; 50-ms photostimulation; one stimulus per fly; in the dark
sensory_condition: unrestrained fly on 5 x 5 mm glass platform (FlyPEZ), dark, 6,000 frames/s side and bottom views
penetrance: takeoff 17/325 (5.2%) vs Empty 25/600 (4.2%), NS (Bonferroni); DNp03 T2-leg postural shift NS vs Empty (pooled lines)
n_flies_note: 325 flies for takeoff; posture (Fig. 1e) pooled over both DNp03 lines, n = 289
notes: figure: DNp03 is not named in the main text; the per-line takeoff rate is in Extended Data Fig. 1e and its source data (DNp03 (SS01081) bar, NS), and the flat DNp03 T2-leg-angle trace is in Fig. 1e,f (pooled, 'Empty vs. DNp03 ns' in Supplementary Table 1). The quote states the result by exclusion. Legs are coded no as a no-visible-effect result in a set where every tested LC4-DN line is reported, but only takeoff and T2 posture were scored over about 100 ms, so stepping was not explicitly scored and confidence is low. Sex is not stated for the FlyPEZ experiments. The paper's own LC4-receptive-field model is not a Pugliese-type score.
